theme.rationale: Travel relies heavily on vibrant imagery (destinations, food, beaches) which pops best against a clean, bright canvas. We're using an 'Organic & Earthy' archetype to convey trust, relaxation, and grounded exploration.

headings.instruction: Do not use generic fonts for headings. Use Outfit for a modern, geometric yet friendly aesthetic.

body.instruction: Clean, highly readable humanist sans for dense data like itineraries and expenses.

primary.description: Deep Forest Green for primary actions, buttons, and progress fills. Conveys growth and nature.

secondary.description: Warm sand / Bone-white for secondary surfaces, card backgrounds, and chips.

accent.description: Terracotta for highlighting important alerts, negative expenses, or 'hot' AI recommendations.

global.mobile: Sticky bottom navigation bar (Glassmorphism), main content has pb-24 to avoid clipping.
global.desktop: Left sidebar navigation, max-width layout for main content to prevent over-stretching.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. Map out sections with gap-8 or gap-12.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_radii: Use rounded-3xl for large images/cards, rounded-full for buttons/chips. Never use sharp corners for this organic theme.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse, soft shadows. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] for floating elements.
visual_enhancers.hero_overlays: bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-black/20 to-transparent. Ensures bottom text is readable while image breathes.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use subtle topography/map illustrations and warm empty state messages instead of blank screens.

AI_Trip_Planner.style: Conversational or step-by-step form. Multi-select interests should be large, pill-shaped chips (bg-secondary text-foreground) that turn primary when selected. Smooth transitions on selection.
AI_Trip_Planner.instruction: Never use native HTML select. Use custom clickable div chips.

Itinerary_Timeline.style: Vertical timeline feed. Left column: time/day label. Right column: Card with activity. Connect with a dashed vertical border-l-2.
Itinerary_Timeline.instruction: Use distinct icons for different activity types (fork for food, bed for hotel). Incorporate map links in the cards.

Expense_Calculator.style: Dense, functional UI. Progress bar mapping total spent vs budget. Categories (Food, Stay, Transport) broken down with minimal horizontal bar charts.
Expense_Calculator.instruction: Use Shadcn Progress component. Provide offline fallback UI cues (e.g., 'Syncing...' badge).

Navigation.style: Mobile Bottom Nav: Glassmorphism base, primary icon colored when active. Desktop Sidebar: Clean solid background with generous padding.
Navigation.instruction: Bottom nav must float slightly off the bottom edge (mb-4) with rounded-full styling.

motion.hover: Slight lift -translate-y-1, shadow increase, and color tint.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion staggered fade-in for lists (like itineraries).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Forest Green meets APCA/WCAG ratios. Use text-shadow on hero images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., 'create-trip-btn', 'expense-input', 'ai-planner-submit').

icons_and_assets.instruction: Use Duotone or Regular weights. They fit the premium, organic feel better than default icons.

trip_covers.description: Tokyo city night - Ideal for Japan itinerary covers
Paris cafe day - Ideal for Europe / Food itinerary covers
Beautiful beach bali - Ideal for relaxation/nature trips

placeholders.description: Map topography background placeholder for Map view when API key is missing

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute npm install / yarn add for required packages: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, sonner.
Setup Tailwind config to include the custom colors (primary: #166534, secondary: #F2F0E9, accent: #E27B58) and fonts (Outfit, DM Sans).
Replace generic App.css centering with a responsive app shell layout: Bottom tab bar on mobile, Sidebar on Desktop.
Build Shadcn components (Button, Input, Progress, Dialog) but heavily override their default Vercel-like styles to match the 'Organic & Earthy' theme (rounder corners, warmer grays).
Construct the AI Trip Planner as a visually rich form, using large selectable pill chips for 'Interests' instead of standard dropdowns.
Implement the Itinerary timeline using flexbox or CSS grid with a continuous left border line to map out days.
Implement the Map tab using the placeholder topography image, centered with a 'Map API Key Required' blurred overlay message.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (e.g., when expenses are saved offline/synced).
NEVER use generic placeholder text or empty dummy images. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Ensure every screen looks pristine on a 375px wide viewport (Mobile First).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid colors or very subtle tonal shifts.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or balanced left-aligned layouts for readability.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and floating elements.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robot/brain) for icons. Use the Phosphor icon library.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
